TITLE: FULL RUN v2 -- 899 primary-policy patches, claude-haiku-4-5, condition C, 3 semantic runs, K=3 counterexamples, Stage 2B every patch. FINAL numbers (not preliminary).

detection_lopo_primary.note: Detection is per-method per protocol.yaml, replacing the earlier placeholder PVS*<0.5.

M2_diff_feature.note: v1 handcrafted diff features -- not static analysis

M4_counterexample.binary_rule: OVERFITTING iff S_cex < 1.0 (candidate fails at least one VALID_BUG_REVEALING test), computed only on patches where S_cex is available; S_cex==NA -> abstain (not predicted).

detection_lopo_primary.baseline_caveat: M0 majority is degenerate in this balanced pilot sample (52% overfitting): the training-fold majority class flips between LOPO folds, so M0 behaves like a near-random classifier (MCC < 0) rather than an all-one-class baseline. Claims of improvement must rest on M1/M2, not M0.

static_complete_case_sensitivity.note: no imputation; LOPO logistic regression on complete cases only
